vi: Dựng guardrail production-grade trên GCP Organization bằng Org Policy: tạo Folder dưới Organization, khai báo boolean constraint (cấm VM external IP), list constraint (pin domain member), và hiểu cách chúng kế thừa xuống project con.

Phân biệt Org Policy vs IAM: Org Policy quản hình dạng resource tồn tại (resource shape), IAM quản ai được gọi API nào (who-does-what), và Org Policy thắng IAM — developer có roles/owner vẫn bị cấm tạo VM public.

Viết Terraform resource Folder, google_org_policy_policy (boolean/list constraint), và folder-level IAM binding, hiểu từng argument (enforce, allowed_values, inherit_from_parent) theo Terraform Registry.

So sánh Org Policy với AWS SCP: AWS SCP là policy document attach vào OU, GCP Org Policy là binding gắn lên node Resource Manager; GCP boolean constraint đơn giản hơn SCP JSON, nhưng GCP không có effect:Deny trong binding thường.
Giải thích vì sao Org Policy chặn được cả developer có admin, và tính toán effective constraint khi merge từ parent hay thay thế bằng inherit_from_parent:false.
en: Build production-grade guardrails on a GCP Organization using Org Policy: create a Folder under Organization, declare boolean constraints (forbid VM external IPs), list constraints (pin member domains), and understand how they inherit down to child projects.

Distinguish Org Policy from IAM: Org Policy governs resource shape (what can exist), IAM governs who-does-what (who can call which API), and Org Policy wins — an owner-role developer is still blocked from creating a public VM.

Write Terraform for Folder, google_org_policy_policy (boolean and list variants), and folder-level IAM binding, mastering each argument (enforce, allowed_values, inherit_from_parent) per Terraform Registry.

Compare Org Policy to AWS SCP: AWS SCP is a policy document attached to an OU, GCP Org Policy is a binding on a Resource Manager node; GCP boolean constraints are simpler than SCP JSON, but GCP has no explicit deny inside normal bindings.
Explain why Org Policy can block an admin developer, and compute effective constraints when inheriting from parent or replacing via inherit_from_parent:false.
